ai.summary: China has approved DeepSeek and MiniMax to continue exporting certain AI technologies, despite recently proposing licensing restrictions covering large models, agents and computing clusters. Open-source-licensed technology is exempt from the restrictions, according to the report.
ai.title: After threatening AI export bans, China allows DeepSeek to keep selling

ai.summary: U.S. lawmakers and White House officials are reportedly urging AI executives to focus public messaging on safer products, amid political criticism of their warnings about catastrophic risks. The article also reports that the FTC sought information from OpenAI and Anthropic about security incidents involving AI agents.
ai.title: White House to AI Chiefs: Say Less, Build Safer Products

ai.summary: Virginia’s Executive Directive 6 calls for a statewide plan to prevent and respond to cyberattacks involving AI, creation of a Cyber Consortium, and regular briefings with AI companies, researchers and regulators. The directive was issued on October 23, according to the briefing.
ai.title: The Daily AI Briefing: 26 October 2026

ai.summary: Anthropic says it will dedicate 5% of its shares to a new public-benefit fund, while its founders have pledged a large portion of their equity to charitable giving. The article examines how AI-company wealth could reshape philanthropy and raises questions about the fund’s structure and transparency.
ai.title: From Carnegie to Claude: AI wealth could reshape philanthropy

ai.summary: Countries are trying to benefit from both U.S.- and China-led AI and technology blocs without alienating either side, as competition between the two powers intensifies. The report describes growing pressure on governments to choose partners for investment, manufacturing and supply chains.
ai.title: As US and China form AI blocs, countries increasingly torn between them

quantum.summary: Researchers demonstrated simultaneous control of five silicon spin qubits using a shared microwave line. Their calibration method kept fidelity above 99.99% with up to three qubits operating at once, and about 99.9% with all five active—a step toward scaling silicon-based quantum hardware.
quantum.title: Scientists overcome a hidden obstacle to more powerful quantum computers

quantum.summary: Researchers from Rutgers, IBM and collaborators used an IBM Heron processor to run repeated measurements, resets and control operations across as many as 100 qubits. The experiment demonstrated real-time feedback at scale, a technique relevant to future fault-tolerant systems, though it was not a complete quantum error-correction system.
quantum.title: Anthropic navrhuje kvantové obvody, rekordní opravy kvantových chyb, korekce v reálném čase

quantum.summary: A report on work by Phasecraft and Virginia Tech says AI agents cut quantum compilation costs by as much as 73% against published methods, with solutions verified. The result points to a potential way to reduce the resources required to run quantum algorithms.
quantum.title: Phasecraft And Virginia Tech Researchers Cut Quantum Compilation Costs By 73% With AI

quantum.summary: Google announced a $150,000 Kaggle competition challenging researchers to use AI to reduce the size and gate count of circuits for fusion, optimization and chemistry problems. The company says its Gemini models have already found more efficient designs in the challenge’s categories.
quantum.title: Google (GOOGL) Launches $150K AI Contest to Cut Quantum Computing Costs

quantum.summary: A report describes a theoretical proposal for a photon-based “time qubit,” drawing on an earlier experiment. The underlying measurements may meet some prerequisites, but the report notes that actual reversal of time evolution and complete control of such a qubit have not been demonstrated.
quantum.title: Scientists may have built a quantum device that runs backward in time
